record.label: Batch readout and recovery of remaining targets
record.statement: One final marking query identifies all remaining targets in the current subset. The circuit records them together and uses further passes or exact loops to find any targets still missing.
record.boundary: A fixed-size pass uses one parallel marking round to find new hits in its current subset. In a walk that uses more than one group of query registers, the final readout can require one round per group. The whole program handles outcomes with targets still missing, including zero-hit batches.
